A new digital layer can connect businesses, banks, and payment providers to bridge this gap. This system will digitise the order-to-cash process and automate invoice reconciliation across the nation. It enables cash-flow-based underwriting and addresses delayed receivables for small businesses.

banking-economy.title: Bank strike halts work at 7,000 branches in MP, affects business worth Rs 5,500 crore: Association
banking-economy.summary: Bank operations halted across Madhya Pradesh due to a nationwide strike. Approximately 7,000 branches were affected, impacting daily business worth Rs 5,500 crore. Employees demanded a five-day work week and improved pension benefits. Other demands included uniform dearness allowance and NPS option. This strike disrupted cash, cheque, and treasury-related financial activities.
